work.title: Benefit Package
work.description: Painted depiction of a large wooden shipping crate labeled 'BENEFIT PACKAGE' in magenta lettering, with upward-pointing arrows on its base. Above the crate, a white cloud-like form with blue outlines floats, set against a softly washed pink and lavender background with downward arrows flanking the scene.
work.composition: central crate beneath floating cloud form
